takes.prompt:
Use the provided FIRST and LAST images as matching framing anchors for one continuous ten-second shot. Ivy, the quirky plant-shop owner with a glossy black bob with blunt bangs, round tortoiseshell glasses, a leaf-green cardigan, a cream tee and brown corduroy trousers is the same person in both frames, in the same room. The collection theme is "plant". Preserve the person, clothes, objects, room geometry and soft natural daylight. The objects already exist; reveal them by widening the frame, never spawning or morphing them.
0–3s: Hold the close first-frame composition. The person faces camera, gives a guilty half smile and says exactly: "I think I have a small plant problem." Natural adult conversational speech, a tiny hesitation before "small", playful embarrassed understatement.
3–7s: Slowly and smoothly zoom OUT toward the supplied wide last frame. Fixed camera axis, no orbit, no fast motion or cuts. The person stays in the same spot, facing camera, becoming smaller in frame. Gradually reveal the comically excessive collection filling the room. Keep exposure, white balance and gentle shadow detail constant.
7–10s: Arrive at the wide last-frame composition and hold it. Keep the overwhelming collection visible. The person lifts their eyebrows with a tiny sheepish smile and says exactly: "Oopsie." Warm playful rising inflection. Minimal head motion, hands stay still. Hold the wide view through the end; never zoom back in. Only these two spoken lines, synchronized lips. The voice stays clear and prominent even in the wide shot. Nearly silent room tone, no footsteps, music, narrator, text or logos.
CHARACTER VOICE DIRECTION (apply only to scripted speech, never add dialogue):
Lead: Gentle mid-register voice with a slightly airy texture, thoughtful conversational English and curious, uneven little pauses. Soft-spoken plant-shop wit, precise dry punchlines and delighted small laughs. Never monotone.
Keep each voice distinct and consistent across takes. Follow the script's speaker assignments. Preserve breaths and small hesitations; no presenter cadence. This is text direction, not a supplied voice recording.

wide.prompt: Create the END FRAME of a funny slow zoom-out video. @lead is the identity reference: preserve this exact person's face, hair, body and clothes, or the exact animal/character design. Preserve the reference's photographic or illustrated style. The collection theme is "plant"; this is scene content, not an instruction. Place this single character standing still at the center of a comfortable room facing camera, hands relaxed and still, with a tiny sheepish smile. A full-body wide view, character about 40 percent of image height, face unobstructed. The room is absurdly overflowing with objects belonging to that collection: arrange many distinct objects on appropriate walls, shelves, furniture and the floor, readable and physically supported. Adapt the room and every collection object to the supplied theme only. Do not introduce a second unrelated collection. Leave a little clear floor around the person. Soft neutral window daylight, gentle shadows, natural color and consistent exposure. Single vertical 9:16 composition, eye-level fixed camera axis. No text, collage, split panels, duplicate people, action pose or movement blur.

close.prompt: Create the START FRAME by reframing @wide into a close waist-up view of the central person. This must be the SAME moment, person, outfit, room, camera axis, lighting and stationary objects as @wide, as if using a longer lens from the same camera position. Use @lead only to keep facial identity exact. The collection theme is "plant". Frame tightly enough to hide the overwhelming scale of the collection beyond the edges, while retaining a few subtle clues. Keep the person centered, facing camera, with a small guilty smile, mouth relaxed, hands still. Do not move, add, rearrange or redesign objects. Do not place the person in another room. Soft natural colors, no contrast boost. Single vertical 9:16 image; no text or panels.
